description: Enforcement summary for WebSocket real-time dashboard updates. Discovered that server-side infrastructure was 90% complete, only dashboard integration was missing. Applied changes to SystemOverview component to enable real-time updates.

discoveredState.summary: WebSocket infrastructure 90% complete - server fully implemented, dashboard integration was the only missing piece

changesApplied.changeMade: Integrated useWebSocket hook with message handler that refreshes templates on execution_completed and template_updated events. Added WebSocket connection status indicator (Live/Reconnecting) in header with Wifi/WifiOff icons.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for real-time dashboard updates without polling. Dashboard now receives WebSocket events and updates UI reactively.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects SystemOverview component UI. No breaking changes. WebSocket connection is optional (graceful degradation if server unavailable).

beforeAfter.before: Dashboard used useTemplates hook with no WebSocket integration. Updates via polling only.
beforeAfter.after: Dashboard calls useWebSocket hook, receives execution_completed and template_updated events, refreshes templates reactively. Connection status indicator shows Live/Reconnecting state.

changesApplied.codeAnnotation: WebSocket integration enables <100ms real-time updates vs previous 5-second polling. Connection resilience via useWebSocket auto-reconnect.

alreadyImplemented.details: Singleton WebSocketBroadcaster with emit(), addClient(), removeClient(), emitToSession(), emitToOrg() methods fully implemented. Supports filtering by session and org.
WebSocket server with upgrade handler for /ws endpoint, authentication (token validation), ping/pong keepalive, client lifecycle management (open, message, close, drain).
Emits 3 event types: execution_started (before DB insert), execution_completed (after Thompson update), template_updated (after metrics calculation). All broadcast to authenticated WebSocket clients.
Full WebSocket client with connectWebSocket(), disconnectWebSocket(), sendWebSocketMessage(). Handles authentication, error handling, connection state.
Complete TypeScript definitions: WebSocketMessage union type, ExecutionStartedMessage, ExecutionCompletedMessage, TemplateUpdatedMessage, PodStatusChangedMessage.
Production-ready React hook with connection state, auto-reconnect (exponential backoff, max attempts), message handling, sendMessage wrapper, cleanup on unmount.
